SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............ 7998
S.I, Special Branch. Section 7 87
REPORT
Date July 13, 19 37.

Subject D. Negulescu-Olt -- Enquiry from Italian Authorities.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by C. Gauson S I

Dumitru Negulescu-Olt accompanied by his wife Maria
Angela Negulescu-Olt arrived in Shanghai aboard the s.s.
"Aramis" on 22.1.37. On his alien registration papers
Negulescu stated that his nationality was Roumanian and that
he was born in Scornicesti-Olt on 24th August 1902. His
passport number was given as 124893, issued at the Roumanian
Consulate in Alexandria on 17th July 1936 and visaed on 15th
January 1937 in Saigon. His occupation was given as that of
engineer. As reference Negulescu gave the Greek Consulate
in Shanghai; enquiries, however, made at this source proved
negative, the authorities concerned claiming that they had no
knowledge of him.

Negulescu travelled to Shanghai from Addis- Ababa where
it is reported he was employed by the Italian Government as an
aviation expert. It is in the latter capacity that he is
believed to have visited China and he is said to have been
promised employment by the Chinese Government.

On arrival in Shanghai Negulescu and his wife took up
residence at No. 1204 Bubbling Well Road, the home of Paul
Exacustin, believed to be a Russian, who owns a house decorating
business situated at the above address. Shortly after his
arrival Negulescu went to Nanking where he was interviewed by
certain government officials, it is believed in connection with
aviation. On his return to Shanghai he found that his wife
was seriously ill and arranged for medical treatment. In this
connection he incurred expenses amounting to $300.

On 22 May, Negulescu left Shanghai for Canton aboard the
s.s. "Haichen"; he was followed on 13 June by his wife on the
s.s. "President McKinley"

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............ 7998
S.I, 特别处。第7科 87号
报告
日期 1937年7月13日。

事由 D. Negulescu-Olt -- 意大利当局查询。

撰写人 D.S. Henchman 转呈人 C. Gauson S I

Dumitru Negulescu-Olt 与其妻 Maria Angela Negulescu-Olt 于1937年1月22日乘“阿拉米斯”号（s.s. "Aramis"）轮抵达上海。在其外侨登记文件中，Negulescu 声明其国籍为罗马尼亚，于1902年8月24日出生于 Scornicesti-Olt。其护照号码为124893，由罗马尼亚驻亚历山大领事馆于1936年7月17日签发，并于1937年1月15日在西贡签证。其职业申报为工程师。Negulescu 提供的担保人为上海希腊领事馆；然而，经向该处查询，结果是否定的，有关当局声称对其一无所知。

Negulescu 从亚的斯亚贝巴（Addis- Ababa）前往上海，据报他在那里受雇于意大利政府，担任航空专家。据信他正是以后者身份访问中国，并称中国政府已承诺予以聘用。

抵达上海后，Negulescu 夫妇寓居静安寺路1204号，此处为 Paul Exacustin 的住所，据信其为俄国人，在上述地址经营一家房屋装饰商行。抵达不久，Negulescu 前往南京，据信因航空事宜接受某些政府官员的问询。返回上海后，他发现妻子病重，遂安排医疗救治。在此过程中，他产生了共计300元的费用。

5月22日，Negulescu 乘“海辰”号（s.s. "Haichen"）轮离开上海前往广州；其妻于6月13日乘“麦金莱总统”号（s.s. "President McKinley"）轮随后前往。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............

REPORT                        ............Station,
(2)                           Date....................19

Subject.......................................................................

Made by....................................Forwarded by....................................

While in Shanghai Negulescu attempted, at first un-
successfully, to negotiate two Italian Bank orders in his
possession; he is reported to have been ultimately successful
in his attempt but made no effort to liquidate the debt incurred
during the course of his wife's illness.

Mr. Beraha, the gentleman mentioned by the Italian
authorities as being a friend of Negulescu's, has been inter-
viewed but stating that he cannot understand why he should have
been named as a reference, claims that he has neither seen nor
heard of Negulescu. Telephone No. 13091 is Mr. Beraha's
office number.

Efforts to ascertain Negulescu's forwarding address in
Canton have proved unsuccessful.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（左侧手写批注：D.B.C. 13/7）
（右侧签名：D. S. MacLaren）

报告                        ............分局，
(2)                           日期....................19

事由.......................................................................

撰写人....................................转呈人....................................

在上海期间，Negulescu 曾试图兑现其持有的两张意大利银行汇票，起初未获成功；据报他最终成功兑现，但未努力偿还其妻患病期间所欠债务。

意大利当局提及的 Negulescu 之友 Beraha 先生已接受问询，但他声称不明白为何被提名为担保人，并表示既未见过也未听说过 Negulescu。13091 号为 Beraha 先生的办公室电话。

经查证 Negulescu 在广州的转寄地址，但未获成功。

副警务处长（特别处）。

（左侧手写批注：D.B.C. 13/7）
（右侧签名：D. S. MacLaren）

Date 3 JUNE 1937
(Special Branch) Office Notes

P. A
Mr Machine telephones :—
A Romanian , one Megolarusco (?) & wife
arrived from Addis Abbaba in possession of
two Italian Bank notes (specimens) . These
can only be cashed abroad with permission of
Italian Govt .
Such permission was applied for & has
been been obtained .
In the meantime Megolarusco wife fell
sick & was treated by an Italian Doctor

（批：S / DS Henderson / DBR / 30/6）

Date
(Special Branch) Office Notes

Doctor
at cost of about $ 300 .
Megolarusco has now returned to
his Consulate . It is thought he has
(a) negotiated his Bank notes
(b) intends to return to Doctor .
He lives with one Mr Beraka
Telephone 13091 . Address unknown .
Mr Machine over telephone this afternoon
says thinks Megolarusco will be evasive . He
asks that Police take no action except to
follow Megolarusco if he goes out or moves
his residence .

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 3 JUNE 1937）

P. A
Machine 先生致电称：—
一名罗马尼亚人，Megolarusco (?) 及其妻子
从亚的斯亚贝巴抵达，持有
两张意大利银行票据（样本）。这些票据
仅在获得意大利政府许可的情况下
方可在国外兑现。
已申请此类许可并
已获得批准。
在此期间，Megolarusco 的妻子生病，
并由一名意大利医生诊治

（批注：S / DS Henderson / DBR / 6月30日）

日期
（特别处）办公笔记

医生
费用约为300元。
Megolarusco 现已返回
其领事馆。认为他已
(a) 兑现了其银行票据
(b) 打算返回医生处。
他与一位 Beraka 先生同住
电话 13091。地址不详。
Machine 先生今天下午通过电话
